lines.text: Lesson sixteen: trend and market structure.
lines.say: Lesson sixteen: trend and market structure.

lines.text: We'll read the shape of price, one peak and dip at a time.
lines.say: We'll read the shape of price, one peak and dip at a time.

lines.text: Here is a fictional BTC chart. Is price going up, down, or nowhere?
lines.say: Here is a fictional B-T-C chart. Is price going up, down, or nowhere?

lines.text: One candle cannot tell you. Look at the peaks and the dips instead.
lines.say: One candle cannot tell you. Look at the peaks and the dips instead.

lines.text: The pattern they make is called market structure.
lines.say: The pattern they make is called market structure.

lines.text: It describes the past. It does not promise the future.
lines.say: It describes the past. It does not promise the future.

lines.text: A swing high is a peak: price rose, then turned down.
lines.say: A swing high is a peak: price rose, then turned down.

lines.text: A swing low is a dip: price fell, then turned up.
lines.say: A swing low is a dip: price fell, then turned up.

lines.text: Think of a hilly road. The hilltops are swing highs, the valleys swing lows.
lines.say: Think of a hilly road. The hilltops are swing highs, the valleys swing lows.

lines.text: A peak is only clear after price turns away from it.
lines.say: A peak is only clear after price turns away from it.

lines.text: An uptrend has higher highs and higher lows.
lines.say: An uptrend has higher highs and higher lows.

lines.text: Each peak tops the last one: 60,100, then 60,200, then 60,300.
lines.say: Each peak tops the last one: sixty thousand one hundred, then sixty thousand two hundred, then sixty thousand three hundred.

lines.text: Each dip stays above the last one: 59,980, then 60,080, then 60,180.
lines.say: Each dip stays above the last one: fifty-nine thousand nine hundred eighty, then sixty thousand eighty, then sixty thousand one hundred eighty.

lines.text: Like climbing stairs: a step up, a small step back, then up again.
lines.say: Like climbing stairs: a step up, a small step back, then up again.

lines.text: HH means higher high. HL means higher low.
lines.say: Higher high means higher high. Higher low means higher low.

lines.text: A downtrend is the mirror: lower highs and lower lows.
lines.say: A downtrend is the mirror: lower highs and lower lows.

lines.text: Peaks: 60,320, then 60,220, then 60,120. Each one is lower.
lines.say: Peaks: sixty thousand three hundred twenty, then sixty thousand two hundred twenty, then sixty thousand one hundred twenty. Each one is lower.

lines.text: Dips: 60,200, then 60,100, then 60,000. LH and LL for short.
lines.say: Dips: sixty thousand two hundred, then sixty thousand one hundred, then sixty thousand. Lower high and lower low for short.

lines.text: Lower highs, lower lows: a downtrend, so far.
lines.say: Lower highs, lower lows: a downtrend, so far.

lines.text: Sideways means neither: highs and lows stay at about the same levels.
lines.say: Sideways means neither: highs and lows stay at about the same levels.

lines.text: Peaks near 60,200, dips near 60,000. Price moves, but goes nowhere.
lines.say: Peaks near sixty thousand two hundred, dips near sixty thousand. Price moves, but goes nowhere.

lines.text: This is also called a range. No clear direction is an answer too.
lines.say: This is also called a range. No clear direction is an answer too.

lines.text: Now watch structure change as price writes the chart.
lines.say: Now watch structure change as price writes the chart.

lines.text: Higher highs, higher lows: an uptrend.
lines.say: Higher highs, higher lows: an uptrend.

lines.text: Each new label appears only after price turns. That is how swings work.
lines.say: Each new label appears only after price turns. That is how swings work.

lines.text: Then a peak that is not higher: the climb stalls, sideways.
lines.say: Then a peak that is not higher: the climb stalls, sideways.

lines.text: A lower high, then a lower low. The structure has turned down.
lines.say: A lower high, then a lower low. The structure has turned down.

lines.text: Structure tells you what changed. It cannot tell you what comes next.
lines.say: Structure tells you what changed. It cannot tell you what comes next.

lines.text: Let's check with numbers. Compare each peak with the last peak.
lines.say: Let's check with numbers. Compare each peak with the last peak.

lines.text: 60,240 minus 60,290 is minus 50. A lower high.
lines.say: Sixty thousand two hundred forty minus sixty thousand two hundred ninety is minus fifty. A lower high.

lines.text: 60,060 minus 60,150 is minus 90. A lower low.
lines.say: Sixty thousand sixty minus sixty thousand one hundred fifty is minus ninety. A lower low.

lines.text: Both changed: the uptrend's pattern of higher highs and lows is broken.
lines.say: Both changed: the uptrend's pattern of higher highs and lows is broken.

lines.text: A common mistake: one big green candle does not make an uptrend.
lines.say: A common mistake: one big green candle does not make an uptrend.

lines.text: Here, a big jump, but the highs and lows are still falling.
lines.say: Here, a big jump, but the highs and lows are still falling.

lines.text: Trend comes from the pattern of swings, not from one candle.
lines.say: Trend comes from the pattern of swings, not from one candle.

lines.text: And always say which timeframe you mean.
lines.say: And always say which timeframe you mean.

lines.text: Your turn. Three fictional charts: A, B and C.
lines.say: Your turn. Three fictional charts: A, B and C.

lines.text: Which is an uptrend, which a downtrend, which sideways? Pause if you need time.
lines.say: Which is an uptrend, which a downtrend, which sideways? Pause if you need time.

lines.text: A: lower highs and lower lows. A downtrend.
lines.say: A: lower highs and lower lows. A downtrend.

lines.text: B: highs and lows at the same levels. Sideways.
lines.say: B: highs and lows at the same levels. Sideways.

lines.text: C: higher highs and higher lows. An uptrend.
lines.say: C: higher highs and higher lows. An uptrend.

lines.text: Well done if you got all three.
lines.say: Well done if you got all three.

lines.text: Be honest about the limits. Spotting swings is partly a judgement call.
lines.say: Be honest about the limits. Spotting swings is partly a judgement call.

lines.text: Two people can mark the same chart differently, and both can be fair.
lines.say: Two people can mark the same chart differently, and both can be fair.

lines.text: Tiny wiggles are usually ignored. A different timeframe can show a different trend.
lines.say: Tiny wiggles are usually ignored. A different timeframe can show a different trend.

lines.text: Before we move on, a few honest limits.
lines.say: Before we move on, a few honest limits.

lines.text: A trend can end at any time, often without warning.
lines.say: A trend can end at any time, often without warning.

lines.text: Buying late into a long trend can mean buying near the top.
lines.say: Buying late into a long trend can mean buying near the top.

lines.text: Structure is not a signal to trade. WAIT and NO_TRADE are always allowed.
lines.say: Structure is not a signal to trade. Wait and no trade are always allowed.

lines.text: Let's recap.
lines.say: Let's recap.

lines.text: Uptrend: higher highs and higher lows. Downtrend: lower highs and lower lows.
lines.say: Uptrend: higher highs and higher lows. Downtrend: lower highs and lower lows.

lines.text: Sideways: highs and lows stay at about the same levels.
lines.say: Sideways: highs and lows stay at about the same levels.

lines.text: Swings are only clear after price turns, and they are a judgement call.
lines.say: Swings are only clear after price turns, and they are a judgement call.

lines.text: Check yourself: peaks 60,300 then 60,240; dips 60,150 then 60,060. What is it?
lines.say: Check yourself: peaks sixty thousand three hundred then sixty thousand two hundred forty; dips sixty thousand one hundred fifty then sixty thousand sixty. What is it?

lines.text: Lower highs and lower lows: a downtrend, so far.
lines.say: Lower highs and lower lows: a downtrend, so far.

lines.text: Great work! Next up: support, resistance, breakout and fakeout.
lines.say: Great work! Next up: support, resistance, breakout and fakeout.

lines.text: See you in lesson seventeen.
lines.say: See you in lesson seventeen.
